settings.title: Account settings
settings.pageDescription: Manage your profile, security, and preferences for your Eleva account.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Update your name and account details managed through WorkOS.
profile.footerHint: Email and identity changes may require verification.
profile.languageError: Could not update language. Please try again.

avatar.title: Profile photo
avatar.description: This is your avatar. Click the photo to upload a custom image from your files.
avatar.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP. Max 2 MB.
avatar.tooLarge: File is too large. Maximum size is 2 MB.
avatar.invalidType: Unsupported file type. Use JPG, PNG, or WebP.
avatar.saveFailed: Could not save avatar. Please try again.
avatar.removeFailed: Could not remove avatar. Please try again.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language used across Eleva apps for your account.
language.footerHint: Applies to account, dashboard, and email notifications where supported.

security.title: Security
security.description: Manage passwords, multi-factor authentication, and sign-in methods.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Review devices and browsers where you are currently signed in.
sessions.footerHint: Revoke sessions you do not recognize.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Eleva
onboarding.subtitle: Let's set up your space, {name}.
onboarding.cardDescription: Your space is where you manage your health journey.
onboarding.processingHint: Setting up your space — this may take a moment.
onboarding.errorMinLength: Space name must be at least 2 characters
onboarding.errorGeneric: We couldn't complete onboarding. Please try again.

organizations.title: Workspaces
organizations.description: Manage your workspaces, create new ones, or switch between them.

createWorkspace.pickerDescription: Choose the type of workspace you want to create.
createWorkspace.errorGeneric: We couldn't create your workspace. Please try again.

expert.title: Expert
expert.description: Run your independent practice on Eleva.
expert.wizardDescription: This is how your workspace will appear in Eleva.

team.title: Team
team.description: Manage multiple experts under one organization.
team.wizardDescription: This is how your workspace will appear in Eleva.

academy.title: Academy
academy.description: Publish and manage courses for your learners.
academy.wizardDescription: This is how your workspace will appear in Eleva.

billing.title: Billing
billing.description: Manage your personal subscription and payment methods.

privacy.title: Privacy & Data
privacy.description: Export your data or delete your account.
